summary: This component renders a blog post item by assembling several sub-components (header, content, footer) inside a container. It also adds a scroll-to-top button at the bottom and applies extra spacing when the post is displayed in a list view rather than on its own page.

explanations.3: This hook from Docusaurus gives us information about whether we're currently viewing a single blog post page or a list of posts.
explanations.12: This custom hook determines what CSS class to apply to the container — it checks if we're in list view and returns a bottom margin class if we are, otherwise returns nothing.
explanations.14: The exclamation mark means 'not' — so this returns the margin class only when we're NOT on the individual blog post page (i.e., when we're in the list view).
explanations.19: The clsx function merges multiple class names together, combining the spacing class from our hook with any additional classes passed in from the parent component.
